```{r}
df_url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmayberr/math133-stat-learning-fall2026/refs/heads/main/Datasets/nba2026.csv"
nba2026 =read.csv(df_url)
head(nba2026)
```

```{r}
player_name="Shai Gilgeous-Alexander"

player_series=nba2026 |>
  dplyr::filter(player==player_name)

head(player_series)
```

Time series

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
player_series = player_series |>
  mutate(fantasy_csum=cumsum(fantasy_points),
         game_date=as.Date(game_date))

player_series |>
  ggplot(aes(x=game_date,y=fantasy_csum))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point(shape=2)
```

Mean/SD of Change Scores

```{r}
cbar=mean(player_series$fantasy_points)
c_sd=sd(player_series$fantasy_points)
c(cbar,c_sd)
```

Control Chart:

```{r}
player_series |>
  ggplot(aes(game_date,fantasy_points))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_point()+
  geom_hline(yintercept=cbar) + # Mean Line
  geom_hline(yintercept=cbar-3*c_sd,linetype = "dashed")+ 
  geom_hline(yintercept=cbar+3*c_sd,linetype = "dashed")
```

Runs test

```{r}
player_series$above_avg=ifelse(
  player_series$fantasy_points>cbar,
  1,
  0
)
table(
  rle(
    player_series$above_avg
    )$lengths
  )
```

```{r}
library(tseries)
runs.test(factor(player_series$above_avg))
```

Autocorrelation Function

```{r}
acf(player_series$fantasy_points)
```
